title: Greece's Recovery Paradox: Strong Macroeconomic Numbers · 13 Oct
keywords: Greece, inflation, cost of living, debt relief, unemployment, Digital Work Card, overtime, labor market, fiscal policy, PASOK, EU economy, Greek recovery, Bank of Greece, Eurostat, working conditions
notes: Greece is posting some of its most encouraging economic indicators in years, with unemployment falling and growth holding steady, yet households and small businesses continue to absorb rising prices and mounting debt obligations. A proposed expansion of tax debt repayment installments has crystallised the tension between fiscal credibility and everyday financial pressure. The political contest is no longer about whether Greece has recovered, but about who is benefiting from that recovery and under what conditions.
